purpose: Typed relationships for the SignalTerrain living knowledge graph. Connect naturally; never force denseness or attribution theater.

types.label: Affects
types.description: A condition or event impacts another topic.

types.label: Uses
types.description: Subject uses an object (technology, protocol, product).

types.label: Targets (literacy)
types.description: Actor or campaign literacy link to a product or CVE. Never stores exploit steps.

types.label: References
types.description: Cites or points to another topic.

types.label: Published by
types.description: Paper or advisory published by an organization.

types.label: Patched by
types.description: Fix published by a vendor — defensive framing.

types.label: Related to
types.description: General useful association — use sparingly.

types.label: Depends on
types.description: Technical or operational dependency.

types.label: Replaces
types.description: Newer topic replaces an older one.

types.label: Supersedes
types.description: Formal supersession (advisory, standard).

types.label: Detects
types.description: Guidance detects a condition — not a scanner product.

types.label: Mitigates
types.description: Guidance or control reduces risk.

types.label: Documented in
types.description: Topic is documented in a paper, RFC, or standard.

types.label: Discovered by
types.description: Discovery credit.

types.label: Reported by
types.description: Report attribution.

types.label: Associated with
types.description: Cautious association when precision is limited.

types.label: Communicates over
types.description: System communicates over a medium, protocol, or frequency.

types.label: Interrupts
types.description: Event interrupts a service or medium.

types.label: Caused by
types.description: Effect linked to a cause — require sources when strong.

types.label: Supports
types.description: Evidence or capability supports a claim or topic.

types.label: Conflicts with
types.description: Sources or claims disagree.

types.label: Observed with
types.description: Co-occurrence worth noting — not forced causality.
